notes.title: Super Life of Pixel Now live
notes.content:
As a thank you to those who have supported Life of Pixel, we have upgraded existing users to Super Life of Pixel for free! 

Here's what we've done to "Super-fy" Pixel, in a nutshell:

[b]*Special Collection*[/b] - 6 brand new, yet totally retro consoles for Pixel to unlock and explore, bringing the total number of classic systems to 19.

[b]*Optimization*[/b] - Super Life of Pixel should run smoother than ever on most machines.

[b]*Bug Stomping*[/b] - Fixed many quality of life bugs after massive QA sweeps and user feedback reports.

[b]*Improved Design*[/b] - Focused on rebalancing specific levels and elements of the game based on user feedback. Players should have a more consistent experience now.

[b]*New Music*[/b] - 6 new chiptune tracks to go along with our new systems.



Right now, the Super edition is only available on PC. Mac and Linux users, or those on PC who prefer the original Life of Pixel experience can still play the “classic” version by opting in through the “betas” tab. Instructions below:

 To use the Classic version.

Step 1: Right Click on Life of Pixel or Super Life of Pixel, and click “Properties”

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6993279/3c03a922712494c47fc4640b1248596e452202ea.jpg[/img]

Step 2: Click on the “Betas” tab and select to opt-in to the “classic” build and hit close. The classic version of Life of Pixel will download and be available in your library. You can always choose to switch between the editions at your will.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6993279/539d0c6847e1a67b7c84986f5f97b96f766d4451.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Support Platform Maker on Greenlight
notes.content:
Hey all

Platform Maker is a continuation of our platform game journey, which began with Life of Pixel.

[b]EVERYONE CAN PLAY & ANYONE CAN CREATE[/b] Add enemies, blocks, power-ups, gravity pads, traps and much more.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=885390692

Choose between RETRO and MODERN themes. Classic computer/console, horror, sci-fi, minimal, and so many more.

Designed with the creativity and accessibility of Minecraft in mind; the base tileset, backgrounds, animations and enemies are swapped out when you select a new theme. We will supply a range of themes at launch, or you can create your own - you can change everything - even the sounds!

[b]Create & Share Your Own Platformer Levels...[/b]

https://youtu.be/DV3ks-n5E-o

Platform Maker is a game about building your own levels and challenges. Play and share amazing courses, from the simplest speedrun to the trickiest of levels. Or play our Super Icon levels, or those created by the community. Create or play, the choice is yours!

notes.title: To Those who have already completed the game Re new Leaderboard
notes.content:
Could you do an update,run the game and wait a bit. 
You do not have to replay any levels, but this will allow times to be synced with the new Leaderboards.
It will also allow you to easily see how well you have done compared to others.

The new Leaderboard gives an overall best game time.

I have currently called it 'Best Accumulated Level Times' but if you can think of a better name please let me know.

Happy Gaming
Steve

notes.title: Version 1.12
notes.content:
- Addition of 3 ‘Hard Core Achievements'

- Controller support improved. Fixed issues with configuring Xbox controller, now possible to map Xbox’s D-Pad. This will have fixed issues with other controllers too

- Controller buttons, such as Start, can now be assigned to bring up pause menu

- Assigning an analogue control to a digital input gives the analogue control a digital response

- Optional camera filter effects added, selectable from the Options and Pause menus

- Jump now allowed after falling/sliding off ledge

- Temporary invincibility added after being hit by an enemy

- Collected Fruit now shown on level select screen

- Machine intro information now displayed when completing a machine and being automatically taken to the next without having to go back to the menus

- Added information about double jumps to initial instructions

- Machine descriptions updated to include some missing processor speeds

- Some other minor bug fixes
